description_en: Triggers the execution of a playbook or a response command
description_zh: 用于触发运行剧本或响应命令
name: TriggerSophonPlaybook

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求幂等性的客户端令牌
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the command to trigger.
You can call the [DescribeSophonCommands](~~DescribeSophonCommands~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
想要触发的命令名称。
调用[DescribeSophonCommands](~~DescribeSophonCommands~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: command_name

parameters.help_en: The input parameters for triggering the command or playbook
parameters.help_zh: 触发命令或剧本的输入参数
parameters.name: input_params

parameters.help_en: The custom ID of the business. If you do not specify this parameter when triggering a playbook, a random ID is generated for troubleshooting
parameters.help_zh: 业务的自定义ID，如果触发剧本时不指定，会产生一个随机的ID，用于排查与定位问题
parameters.name: sophon_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.
You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

command: Triggers a command task.
playbook: Triggers a playbook task
parameters.help_zh:
触发类型，取值：

command：触发命令任务
playbook：触发剧本任务
parameters.name: trigger_type

Data.description_en: The details returned after the command or playbook is triggered
Data.description_zh: 触发命令或剧本后的返回详情

SophonTaskId.description_en: The custom ID of the business. If you do not specify this parameter when triggering a playbook, a random ID is generated for troubleshooting
SophonTaskId.description_zh: 业务的自定义ID，如果触发剧本时不指定，会产生一个随机的ID，用于排查与定位问题

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
